# Orientation Note for profiling_sandbox/jinja2

## Main Entry Points
The main entry point for the Jinja2 codebase is the `Environment` class in `environment.py` (line 22). This class is responsible for managing templates and their runtime and compile time options.

## Core Data Structures
- `Environment`: The central class for managing templates (line 22).
- `Lexer`: Used for preprocessing and separating template code from Python code (line 13).
- `Parser`: Parses tokens into nodes for the compiler (line 22).
- `CodeGenerator`: Compiles nodes into Python code (line 22).

## Error Handling
Error handling is centralized in `exceptions.py`. Key exceptions include:
- `TemplateNotFound`: Raised when a template does not exist (line 15).
- `TemplateSyntaxError`: Raised for syntax errors in templates (line 15).
- `TemplateRuntimeError`: Raised for runtime errors during template execution (line 15).

This overview should help you navigate the core components and error handling mechanisms within the Jinja2 codebase.
